body:
Tested locally with a Wacom Intuos M 2013 graphics tablet, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Performance in the MRPs from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109639 is still on the same level as before when using a 8 kHz mouse.

I don't have access to a touchscreen laptop right now, but @jeffhube reported the fix to be working in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/122791#issuecomment-5428116462.
